title: Certificate-shell projection
statement: Let $C,c$ be nonnegative integers and let $\mathrm{out}$ be any function from pairs of Boolean words to Boolean words. The set of words $x$ for which some word $u$ has length $C(|x|+1)^c$ and $x u$ can be written as $x' u'$ with $|u'|=C(|x'|+1)^c$ and $\mathrm{out}(x',u')=[1]$ equals the set of words $x$ for which some word $u$ has length $C(|x|+1)^c$ and $\mathrm{out}(x,u)=[1]$.
hypotheses_covered: Function $\mathrm{out}$ from pairs of Boolean words to Boolean words
